testCase.name: [local] S06 Dictated unit × temperature range → unit kept exactly as said

descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S06 Dictated unit × temperature range → unit kept exactly as said

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 5)
  • U7 Nothing that was not dictated appears in the transcript: no words invented on silence or noise, no unit added to a bare value. (UAT 3.4)
  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed. (UAT TC-23; TFA-94423 AC 3)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Same setup as S01/S02

When Speak each temperature sentence into the pre-round box

Then Celsius named → Celsius kept; Fahrenheit named → Fahrenheit kept; no unit said → no unit added; never converted, in any range

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Table: unit dictated (Celsius word / 'C' / Fahrenheit word / none) × range (<36, normal, ≥38) → number exact (numbers check, U1), unit as dictated (U3), no unit added to D-05 (U7, 3.4, Q13). Whether a dropped unit word fails is Q3

Where it ran: local aicheck-dictation (dictation AI checks); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-23.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-94423 ready for qa

Not judged yet: whether a dictated temperature unit is kept exactly as said is blocked on the same OpenAI key approval.

Evidence: allure-results/4d67ece9…: same key precondition block. Self-test 2/2.

Duplicate: the same issue as TC-23/S01; read that one (the kept one). This result carries the label "Duplicate", so a filter can leave it out.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane aicheck-dictation.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: aicheck-dictation.

Detail:

The scripted self-test behind this entry ran before the review fix and used the real prepareSession: each take minted one OpenAI client secret (client.realtime.clientSecrets.create on api.openai.com) with the local key …PUMA — no audio, but the gated key was used.

Evidence: 1 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane B (dictation-ai runner, not built): it plays a fixed synthetic voice into the app's own Dictate through a getUserMedia shim (no real microphone or speaker) on a fresh @roundai.test account, spending the local OpenAI key (laneB-preconditions)..
